import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Filter out derived features for driver selection
    non_derived_ids = [fid for fid, typ in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) if typ != 'derived']
    
    # Calculate effect sizes (mean difference) and t-stats for all non-derived features
    effects = {}
    tstats = {}
    for fid in non_derived_ids:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, idx]
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, idx]
        effects[fid] = np.mean(y1) - np.mean(y0)
        tstat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(y1, y0, equal_var=False)
        tstats[fid] = tstat
    
    # Sort by absolute t-statistic
    sorted_features = sorted(non_derived_ids, key=lambda f: abs(tstats[f]), reverse=True)
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated with r >= 0.6)
    keep = []
    for fid in sorted_features:
        is_unique = True
        for kept_fid in keep:
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)], feats.x[:, feats.column(kept_fid)])[0,1]) >= 0.6:
                is_unique = False
                break
        if is_unique:
            keep.append(fid)
    
    # Select top features for drivers (at most MAX_DRIVERS)
    drivers = tuple(keep[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # For columns, use all non-derived features with strong effects
    columns = tuple(f for f in non_derived_ids if abs(effects[f]) > 0.1)
    
    # For products, look for interaction terms among top features
    products = set()
    top_features = [f for f in keep[:5] if f in columns]
    
    # Check pairwise correlations to identify potential interactions
    for i, f1 in enumerate(top_features):
        for f2 in top_features[i+1:]:
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(f1)], feats.x[:, feats.column(f2)])[0,1]
            if abs(corr) < 0.3:  # Only consider weakly correlated pairs
                products.add((f1, f2))
    
    # Weighted score: sum of top features weighted by effect size
    loadings = {}
    for fid in top_features:
        loadings[fid] = effects[fid]
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
